my-learning-record.title: My learning record
my-learning-record.purpose: Every learning experience Kafa'a recorded about me as xAPI statements: courses, refreshers, opportunities, rotations, shadowing, JPMs, mentoring and knowledge, with a JSON lines download.

training-lrs.title: Learning record store
training-lrs.purpose: Explore xAPI statements for the people in your scope, see the suppressed analytics that feed effectiveness and needs analysis, and check which Kafa'a events emit statements.

training-lrs-person.title: Learning timeline
training-lrs-person.purpose: One person's learning statements in time order, for an instructor or manager in scope. Every read is audited.

training-lrs-statement.title: Statement
training-lrs-statement.purpose: One stored xAPI statement with its provenance and its xAPI 2.0 JSON.

training-lrs-adapters.title: LRS adapters
training-lrs-adapters.purpose: How an external learning record store would connect to Kafa'a (SIMULATED): Statement API, field mapping, profile and emitters.

training-lrs-console.title: LRS test console

common.mirror: Kafa'a records learning experiences as evidence for development. A statement is not a qualification, a licence decision or a FANR record.

src.m04_course: Recorded automatically when an instructor recorded the course completion in Kafa'a (M04).
src.f14_refresher: Recorded automatically for each knowledge refresher answer (F14).
src.f08_opportunity: Recorded automatically when the host signed off the opportunity (F08).
src.f15_rotation: Recorded automatically when the host manager signed off the rotation placement (F15).
src.f15_shadowing: Recorded automatically when the job-shadowing visit was completed (F15).
src.m05_jpm: Recorded automatically when an evaluator recorded the JPM result (M05). Security-restricted JPMs are never recorded.
src.f13_mentoring: Recorded automatically when a mentoring session was logged (F13).
src.f21_knowledge: Recorded automatically when a knowledge asset was marked as used (F21).
src.f28_simulator: Recorded from a simulator crew debrief (F28).
src.f38_ojt: Recorded from an OJT practice log entry (F38).
src.console: Stored by the person themselves from the admin test console.

reasons.noItem: The practice question itself is never recorded, only the competency and the result.
reasons.profile: Checked against the Kafa'a xAPI 2.0 profile: account actor (no email), registered verb, Kafa'a activity.
reasons.stored: Stored {date}. Append-only: a statement is never edited; corrections are new statements.

detail.title: xAPI statement
detail.jsonNote: The JSON keeps the xAPI field names and IRIs in English, as the standard requires.

mix.hoursSub: from recorded durations (a day counts 8 h)

my.intro: Kafa'a keeps a learning record store in the xAPI format: one statement for each learning experience, from e-learning and classroom courses to refreshers, rotations, shadowing and mentoring.
my.privacy: Statements identify you by your Kafa'a account, never by your email. Your line manager or instructor can read them only while you are in their scope, and every such read is audited. Download everything at any time.
my.emptyBody: Complete a course, answer a refresher or log a mentoring session and it appears here.
my.timelineBody: Newest first. Open a statement to see where it came from and its xAPI JSON.
my.whatBody: The events that write a statement. Planned emitters start when their features go live.

ex.intro: Statements from every Kafa'a learning emitter, for the people in your scope. Analytics roles see aggregates only.
ex.audit: Opening statements about other people writes an audit event. You see only the people in your scope.
ex.emptyBody: Statements appear when people in your scope complete learning.
ex.emittersBody: Each Kafa'a event below appends exactly one statement when it happens. Emitters never change the source record and never block it.

an.privacy: A cell shows only when it covers {n} or more people; smaller groups read suppressed. No person-level data reaches this view.
an.trendBody: Last 12 months. Months with fewer than 10 learners for a verb are gaps.
an.feeds: These suppressed aggregates are the learning-activity input for training effectiveness (F25) and the training needs forecast (F26). Association only: activity is not proof of competence.

event.m04_course: An instructor records a course completion
event.f08_opportunity: The host signs off an opportunity
event.f15_rotation: A rotation placement is signed off
event.m05_jpm: An evaluator records a JPM result
event.f21_knowledge: A knowledge asset is marked as used
event.f28_simulator: A simulator crew debrief is recorded
event.f38_ojt: An OJT practice entry is logged
event.console: An admin stores a test statement about themselves

person.intro: Learning statements for one person in your scope, newest first. This read is audited.
person.out: This person is not in your scope, so their learning record is not shown. The attempt was audited.
person.empty: No statements for this person yet

stmt.intro: A stored xAPI statement: who, what, the result, where it came from and its JSON.
stmt.notFoundBody: It does not exist or it is about someone outside your scope.
stmt.backExplorer: Back to the learning record store

ad.intro: How an external learning record store would exchange xAPI 2.0 statements with Kafa'a. Nothing on this page is connected.
ad.noEndpointTitle: No public endpoint in the demo
ad.noEndpoint: Statements are written only by Kafa'a's own emitters and the admin test console, through an RPC that checks them against the profile. A live connector would forward them to an LRS chosen by ENEC.

stepBody.emit: A Kafa'a event (course completion, refresher answer, sign-off …) writes one statement in the same transaction.
stepBody.validate: The statement is checked against the Kafa'a xAPI 2.0 profile; invalid statements are refused with a schema error.
stepBody.store: It is appended to the store and can never be edited; access follows the person's scope.
stepBody.forward: A connector would POST batches to the external LRS and read them back with the Statement API.

ad.connectorNote: The connector row is listed with the other integrations.

api.post: Store one statement or a batch
api.put: Store a statement with a known id (idempotent)
api.get: Query by person, verb, activity and time window

ad.sampleTitle: What a forwarded statement looks like
ad.sampleBody: A synthetic example. Field names and IRIs stay in English, as the standard requires.
ad.mapNote: The actor is always an account on {home} with the Kafa'a person id; there is no mbox, email or name.

rule.account: Actor: a Kafa'a account only. mbox, mbox_sha1sum, openid and names are refused.
rule.verbs: Verbs: eight ADL verbs (completed, passed, failed, answered, attended, experienced, attempted, progressed).
rule.activities: Activities: Kafa'a IRIs by type (course, scenario, task, refresher …); assessment items are not activities.
rule.response: No free-text result.response: it could carry assessment content.
rule.secure: No secure assessment item id anywhere in a statement.
rule.append: Append-only: no update and no removal; a correction is a new statement.
rule.scope: Reads follow the person's scope; analytics see suppressed aggregates.

ad.emittersBody: Simulator crew debriefs (F28) emit one statement per crew member present. OJT practice logs (F38) will emit through the same function when that feature goes live.

con.intro: Check an xAPI 2.0 statement against the Kafa'a profile and store it about yourself. Use it to show what the store accepts and refuses.
con.warn: The store is append-only. Console statements are about you only and are marked "Test console" everywhere.
con.noPerson: Your account has no Kafa'a person record
con.validBody: The server checks it again when you store it.
con.serverNote: Checked in your browser. The server also checks that the person exists, that the statement is about you and that it carries no secure item id.
con.confirmBody: It is added to your learning record permanently and cannot be edited or removed. Invalid statements are refused with a schema error.
con.mine: Statements I stored from the console
con.mineBody: They also appear in My learning record.

err.not_object: The statement must be a JSON object.
err.too_large: The statement is too large (8,000 characters at most).
err.unknown_field: This field is not part of the Kafa'a profile.
err.lrs_field: Set by the store, not by the sender.
err.id_format: The id must be a UUID.
err.actor_type: The actor must be an Agent.
err.mbox_not_allowed: Email-style identifiers are not allowed: use the Kafa'a account.
err.name_not_allowed: Names are not stored in statements.
err.account_required: The actor needs an account with homePage and name.
err.account_home: The account must be on the Kafa'a home page.
err.unknown_person: No Kafa'a person has this id.
err.verb_required: A verb with an id is required.
err.verb_unknown: This verb is not in the Kafa'a registry.
err.display_format: The display must be a language map of short texts.
err.object_required: An object with an id is required.
err.object_type: The object must be an Activity.
err.object_kind: This activity type is not allowed.
err.name_format: Names and descriptions must be language maps of short texts.
err.secure_content: Secure assessment items can never appear in a statement.
err.result_format: The result must be an object.
err.score_range: The score must be numbers in range (scaled between -1 and 1).
err.bool_format: Success and completion must be true or false.
err.duration_format: The duration must be ISO 8601, for example PT1H30M.
err.response_not_allowed: Free-text responses are not stored: they could carry assessment content.
err.context_format: The context fields must be short texts.
err.registration_format: The registration must be a UUID.
err.timestamp_format: The timestamp must be ISO 8601 with a time zone.
err.timestamp_future: The timestamp is in the future.
